model: Night Train / Standard / Custom / Deuce (Twin Cam)
name: Harley-Davidson Twin Cam Softail (Night Train, Standard, Custom, Deuce)
engine: 88 or 96 cubic inch Twin Cam B V-twin, counterbalanced, carb or fuel injection, belt drive
intro: The Twin Cam Softails. A counterbalanced engine in a rigid-look frame, with carbs or injection depending on year.

E: Twin Cam engines from these years use spring-loaded cam chain tensioners with plastic shoes. Check the shoes for wear before you trust the engine.

recallNote: Harley-Davidson has issued several recalls that touch these years. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start.
